name: Bramble Hairstreak
desc: Bramble Hairstreak (Callophrys affinis): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Callophrys affinis, the western green hairstreak or immaculate green hairstreak, is a butterfly of the family Lycaenidae. It is found in western Canada and the western United States.
